website.meaning: The semantic version assigned to an activated MultiAgentMemory.com static-site release.

endpointApi.meaning: MemoryEndpoints.com API versions belong to the separately deployed endpoint and are never inherited by this companion site.

releaseHistorySchema.meaning: The releases.json document contract version; it is not a website release version.

packageSource.meaning: Repository commits, source candidates, and deployment packages are evidence inputs, not website versions unless a release record explicitly binds them.

releases.title: Public release history and verification foundation
releases.summary: Established the first versioned MultiAgentMemory.com website release with a human-readable production history and a deterministic machine ledger.

changes.summary: Added the canonical no-JavaScript release-history page and releases.json ledger with exact version-scope separation and evidence-bound publication rules.
Published canonical metadata, structured release data, human sitemap coverage, and matching release pointers across the public AI discovery surfaces.
Qualified keyboard focus, semantic navigation, forced colors, reduced motion, narrow mobile reflow, and 200-percent text without clipped or lost content.
Added deterministic source projections plus static, browser, accessibility, geometry, privacy, and regression checks for the public artifact.

milestones.name: First evidence-bound website version
milestones.summary: Separated the MultiAgentMemory.com website version from MemoryEndpoints.com API, release-ledger schema, repository, and package identities.
